name: tag_machine
description: Applies a set of tags to one machine and reports what it applied.

inputs.name: vmName
inputs.description: The machine to tag, by its name in the inventory

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Category name to tag value, one entry per tag

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.description: Report what would be applied without applying it

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when every tag was applied, or would have been in a dry run

outputs.name: error_message
outputs.description: The reason when success is false
